plugin.name: Hidden & Dangerous 2 Widescreen Fix
FixHUD.description: Correct HUD, text and cursor placement for widescreen.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the startup logo videos. Needs a restart.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Applies to the next camera update.
InsertKey.description: Provide the existing fallback when the native game key lookup returns no key.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language for Plugins and other plugins. Automatic falls back to English when the game language cannot be identified. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Plugins.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
